title: How Banks Take Your Money Without Touching It (Inflation Explained) #inflation #islamicfinance
description:
Someone takes money out of your pocket every single day. No receipt. No alert. Nothing. And it's completely legal.

Money isn't printed — it's LENT into existence. A bank approves a loan and the money simply appears. It didn't come out of a vault; it was typed into a screen. Every loan creates new money, but the world's bread didn't multiply. More money, same bread — so bread costs more.

Nobody voted for it. Nobody sent you a bill. But you paid it. That's inflation, and the engine behind it is interest.

You cannot type gold into existence. It has to be dug, weighed, earned. Hold what cannot be diluted.

The fix — sound money, and how to actually hold it — is the next video.

Part 14 of The Money Machine, Decoded.
